title: Flux-Based PMSM
text: Flux-based permanent magnet synchronous motor, 3 inputs, 4 outputs; {Simulation type} selects simulation type, {Sample time, Ts} sets the sample time for discrete integration, {Port Configuration} selects port configuration, {Enable memory optimized 2D LUT} sets the selection, {Vector of d-axis flux, flux_d} sets the flux breakpoints 1 -by, {Resample storage size for flux_d, n1} sets the flux bit size, {Vector of q-axis flux, flux_q} sets the flux breakpoints 1 -by, {Resample storage size for flux_q, n2} sets the flux bit size, {Corresponding d-axis current, id} sets the 2D lookup table M -by, {Corresponding q-axis current, iq} sets the 2D lookup table M -by, {flux_d max endpoint, u1max} sets the flux breakpoint, {flux_d min endpoint, u1min} sets the flux breakpoint, {flux_q max endpoint, u2max} sets the flux breakpoint, {flux_q min endpoint, u2min} sets the flux breakpoint, {Stator phase resistance, Rs} sets the resistance, {Number of pole pairs, P} sets the pole pairs, {Initial flux, fluxdq0} sets the flux, {Initial mechanical position, theta_init} sets the angle, {Initial mechanical speed, omega_init} sets the speed and {Physical inertia, viscous damping, and static friction, mechanical} sets the inertia, damping, friction. Values come from the instance.
